headlines.title: Oil surges after Israel’s attack on Iran, risking ‘stagflationary shock’ – as it happened
Oil and gold prices soar and stock markets fall after Israel’s attacks on Iran
Markets Brace for Turmoil After Israel Strikes Iran
headlines.abstract: Oil prices are up and stocks are down, as investors fear a potential wider regional conflict.

headlines.title: Israel Expands Attack to Include Iran’s Oil and Gas Industry
headlines.abstract: Iran has been battling an acute energy crisis for months because of gas shortages, and repairing any damage would both be costly and take significant time.

headlines.title: Oil Prices Waver After Israel Strikes Iran’s Energy Assets
headlines.abstract: U.S. oil prices already jumped last week, which could cause prices at the pump to rise about 20 cents a gallon in the coming weeks, according to one estimate.
